title: Monster holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#5ec269'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#8ee09a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <path d='M52 60 Q62 52 56 42' stroke='#5ec269' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='61' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='59' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- second eye -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#fffbe8'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='61' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>

  <path d='M38 74 Q44 80 50 74' stroke='#2f8a3a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <polygon points='32,50 28,38 36,48' fill='#f4a83a'/>
